title: INC-3997: service incident, Vendor Portal
body:
## Impact

This report covers an incident on the Vendor Portal that is ongoing. Network
Operations linked roughly 30 tickets to the event and engaged Silverline Data,
the hosting provider, within the first hour.

## Timeline

Zoe Mitchell logged the following events, state as of 21 August 2025:
- The on-call engineer confirmed failed health checks on two nodes
- The previous configuration was redeployed to the whole pool
- A disk on the storage node reported write failures

## Status

For tracking purposes the incident is ongoing. Mateo Silva wrote this report on
5 February 2025 and will review it in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window before the
weekly service meeting.
